title: Register a closed set of build extensions in an AOT host
goal: Choose and verify a fixed resolver, task and logger set when embedding MSBuild in a native host, retaining a managed alternative for reflective execution and observing missing-registration failures.

selectionNotes: The host target is independent of its fixed evaluated project. Native execution is measured, not inferred from metadata or cross-compilation.
Keep the actual SDK10 managed alternative. Static registration does not exist there and the current package has net11.0 assets; no down-level route is advertised.
Retained IL2026 is an explicit limitation. Only the supplied closed set and toolchain were exercised.

platforms: Windows x64, actual ILC11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105, MSVC14.51.36231 cl/link and Windows Kit10.0.26100.0 libraries. No other OS/RID qualification.
prerequisites: Complete official SDK10.0.402/runtime10.0.13 and SDK11RC2/runtime-reference11RC2 for the paired managed proof; official NuGet packages and locked restore.
Supported Windows NativeAOT prerequisite is Visual Studio2022 or later with Desktop development with C++ and Windows SDK components. The listed exact VS18 toolchain was measured and used.
Set QUAY_MSBUILD_SDK to the matching complete SDK directory. Startup selects process-only MSBUILD_EXE_PATH; use fresh disposable processes and trusted fixed project/import files.
PowerShell7 for evidence/inspection; SDK10 and Node22.19+ for installed tool inspection. Native build uses absolute executables and child-only INCLUDE/LIB without PATH or persistent setting edits.
constraints: Only the compiled Quay.Permits resolver, IssueQuayPermit string input/output task and direct ILogger instances are qualified; evaluation is distinct from target execution.

IL2026 remains visible at BuildManager.Build. WarningsNotAsErrors retains it as a warning; no suppression, analyzer-clean or general MSBuild AOT-safety claim. New diagnostics or extensions need fresh qualification.

Dynamic resolver/task/logger loading, project-cache plugins, workloads, solutions, generic TaskItem<T> binding, server reuse and performance claims are outside this evidence. This is not an untrusted-project sandbox.

Task registration is by simple type name and wins over UsingTask/runtime/architecture identities. Register the process-wide resolver/task set before first evaluation/build; parameter type registration is a separate responsibility.

Native missing task yields MSB4283, missing resolver MSB4282. The verified older managed alternative retains UsingTask/directory SDK loading and missing-task failure. No target10 catalogue route added.
optIns: PublishAot=true and win-x64 with the exact RC2 toolchain; allowPrerelease=true in global.json.
Explicit import of the pinned public Framework package target and retained, inspected IL2026 build diagnostic. No -mt, diagnostic-ID experimental or preview-language opt-in.
stabilityLimitations: Preview-qualified .NET11 SDK/runtime/package integration; package version numerals do not establish GA framework support.
Actual-GA/PIN-963, PIN-959 qualifying coverage/evidence, exactly eight .NET10 foundations and unrelated Human gates remain open.
